RNE, CPU FTZ/DAZ off, MKL_NUM_THREADS=4/OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 under cpu-run before GPU; no SYCL/LevelZero/GPU link. Reuse exact S62 selected36 as independent sanity.
CPU_precompute_before_GPU.A_upper: Outward-rounded Ahat/(1-g(2560,2^-53)); implementation must enclose every scalar arithmetic operation, not only add a final nextafter
CPU_precompute_before_GPU.target: For EVERY initial and changed GU output of BOTH algorithms: abs(float64(y)-T64) <= outward[(g(2560,2^-24)+g(2560,2^-53))*A_upper]; A_upper=0 requires y==0, either signed zero allowed. Outward enclose the residual computation too.

CPU_precompute_before_GPU.reference_uncertainty: E64=outward[g(2560,2^-53)*A_upper]; separate from B32=outward[g(2560,2^-24)*A_upper]. Acceptance distance to rounded reference includes B32+E64; it is not a vendor proof.

No model-quality, serving qualification, all-context or 2000tok/s claim. A wave micro win is only a reason to consider a bounded production-shaped prefill screen.
